register_roles.rsi: &files - the three 8-byte fields of the std::vector header: begin at +0x0, end at +0x8, capacity at +0x10; the body reads begin and end only
register_roles.rdi: the CompactionPicker receiver (`this`); the body never reads it
register_roles.rax: files.end first, then the walk index i (the low 32 bits are zeroed by `xor %eax,%eax`)
register_roles.rcx: files.begin, kept in a register for the whole walk
register_roles.rdx: files[i], then the zero-extended flag byte read from that element
register_roles.eax: the returned byte: 0, or the flag byte itself

caller_census.contract: returns a byte predicate: 0 when no element carries a non-zero byte at +0xb4, otherwise that byte (in practice 1)

consumer_meaning.arithmetic: the predicate is consumed by a test/cmp/xor/movzx at the call site - five callers use `test %al,%al` and one inverts it with `xor %eax,1`
consumer_meaning.returned: the caller forwards the predicate as its own return value: the byte is copied to the callee-saved ebx, survives an intervening `call` (which is why the taint kill must follow the ABI, not `call` alone), and is moved back to eax at the epilogue
consumer_meaning.stored: the caller spills the predicate into a local (`mov byte ptr [rbp - 0x195],al`) before using it

call_sites.note: `xor eax,1` - the caller asks for the negation
the predicate becomes the caller's return value

caller_census.reachability_note: The first-use walk follows the linear fall-through path inside the caller's FDE and drops taint when a register is overwritten and at every intervening `call`; a conditional branch does not clobber registers and is not treated as one, so a value that only dies on a branch path would still be reported as read. Every one of the nine sites reaches its use on the fall-through path, so no site is path-dependent here.
caller_census.method: Capstone linear sweep of .text, direct-call filter on the entry, FDE attribution from .eh_frame, then a taint walk of rax/eax/al forward inside the owning FDE (regs_access-based, ABI call kills applied).

observations: The routine is a leaf with no call, no indirect branch, no relocation and no memory write: its static memory effect is exactly four loads (vector begin, vector end, one element pointer, one flag byte).

The element count is derived as `n = (end - begin) >> 3` with a signed shift, then compared with an unsigned `jae` - a valid std::vector always satisfies end >= begin, which the model asserts instead of guessing.
An empty vector is answered from the header alone: `cmp %rcx,%rax; je` jumps straight to the shared exit with edx = 0, so no element pointer is ever dereferenced.
The returned value is the flag byte itself, not a normalised boolean - a build that stored 2 or 0xFF at +0xb4 would return that value through eax.
Both the `not-found` exit and the empty-vector path funnel through the single `mov %edx,%eax` at 0x5d9a3c8, so the routine has one return site.
The walk is a rotated do-while: the increment and bound test sit at the back edge (0x5d9a3b0/0x5d9a3b4) after a 2-byte `xchg %ax,%ax` alignment nop.

All nine call sites read the returned byte - none discards it - and the census shows three distinct shapes of use: seven arithmetic (one of them an inversion, `xor eax,1`), one forwarded as the caller's own return value, one spilled to a stack local.

The window is int3-fenced on both sides (eight 0xCC bytes below the entry, one 0xCC byte up to the next FDE at 0x5d9a3d0), which is what makes the 63-byte span a complete function body rather than an excerpt of a larger one.

The census taint walk has to model the ABI rather than the instruction: `call` does not report rax among its written registers in Capstone, so the caller-saved kill is applied explicitly - the forward-return site at 0x5d9dae8 is exactly the case that needs it, because it carries the byte across an intervening `call _ZdlPvm` in the callee-saved ebx.
unknowns: Which field of rocksdb FileMetaData sits at +0xb4 in 0.11.0+8.1.1 is inferred from the public 8.1.1 sources (`being_compacted`); the binary fixes the offset, not the name.
The five caller FDEs carry no symbols in the stripped image, so they are identified by address range only - no claim is made about which method each one is.
The three identical source copies the vendor census records (identical_source_count = 3) are not enumerated individually; the reconstruction is bound to the sha256 of the body.
claim_anchors: semantics.tsv: 22 anchors, one per instruction, contiguous over the whole 63-byte window (sizes sum to 63); verify.py re-decodes each anchor's bytes with Capstone (one instruction, same length, same mnemonic family) and matches its text against the committed excerpt
ledger: cases.tsv: 300 stratified rows (empty, clear, first/last/middle position, every subset of vectors up to five elements, dense, alternating, first-wins, several flag values) with the model and the decoded-bytes answer for each; 0 disagreements
sweep: verify.py: every vector of n = 0..40 elements with a flag byte at every position at five values (1, 2, 0x7F, 0x80, 0xFF) plus the all-clear shape, each compared between the closed-form model and the emulator that executes the routine's own bytes
